name: Jukuatsu
source:
In a twist of fate, the protagonist comes into possession of a brand-new house.
Once a broke part-timer, he suddenly finds himself living a life of leisure he could’ve never imagined. But his life takes an even more unexpected turn when he meets Urushibara Chieko, his housekeeper…

This M-themed adventure pits you against a cast of beautiful, unique women—tall, mature beauties, devout saints, innocent girls, and otaku loners—who will drain you of everything you hold dear.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ158120.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
命运的转折让主人公意外得到一栋崭新的房子。

他原本只是个身无分文的兼职工，突然过上了从未想象过的悠闲生活。然而，当他遇到管家漆原千惠子后，人生又朝着更意外的方向发展……

这是一场以M属性为主题的冒险。你将面对一群美丽而独特的女性：高挑成熟的美人、虔诚的圣女、天真的女孩，以及沉迷宅文化的孤独者。她们会夺走你珍视的一切。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ158120.html/]DLsite[/url]]
